sentence: This project studies how Amyloid beta forms are taken up by neurons and become toxic, to better understand Alzheimer's Disease.
This project studies how genetic variants relate to brain structure and function, using large open brain imaging and genomics data.
This project stores and checks brain imaging data and builds analysis pipelines to measure brain structure, function and connectivity in the aging adult brain.
This project studies how changes in synapses and circuits cause problems with thinking and impulse control in Parkinson's Disease, using mice.
This project studies what keeps germ cells from turning into somatic cells, including the roles of Nanos and small RNAs.
This project studies how developing brain cells increase their surface area, to understand healthy brain development.
This project builds computational tools to find the transcriptional regulators that shape eye development and disease.
This project measures how late onset Alzheimer's disease changes protein interactions and protein structure in the endosomal-lysosomal network.
This project designs MRI methods to measure tissue composition and structure, such as myelin and iron, in the brain.
This project tries to find out how a single mutation in a protein that regulates calcium in the heart causes a heritable arrhythmia syndrome.
This project studies how prefrontal circuits in the brain shift social behavior between competition and cooperation.
This project tests a B cell based vaccine as immunotherapy for high grade gliomas, building on results in mice.
This project looks for cellular and molecular markers that predict how head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patients respond to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
This project designs lipid nanoparticles that deliver agents to cancers to trigger an immune response mediated by B cells.
This project studies how genetically identical cells respond differently to the same drugs, using single-cell technologies and computational methods.
This project builds and tests parts of a clinical decision support system that helps clinicians choose treatments for glaucoma patients.
This project studies how chemical probes disrupt a translation factor that bacteria need for stress adaptation and virulence.
This project studies how extreme heat and wildfire smoke particles affect frailty and cognitive function in older people living with HIV.
This project designs a T cell receptor that recognizes two tumor antigens at once, to treat B cell malignancies that relapse.
